onChange.template:
[Gameplan: update .gameplan/statemachine/properties/dash_state.schema.json, set ds_c_mode to {{ds_c_mode}}]
Set dash mode to {{ds_c_mode}}: quick_burst=short distance+short cooldown, standard=defaults, long_lunge=large distance+long cooldown.

[Gameplan: update .gameplan/statemachine/properties/dash_state.schema.json, set ds_t_distance to {{ds_t_distance}}]
Set DashAbility.dashDistance to {{ds_t_distance}}.

[Gameplan: update .gameplan/statemachine/properties/dash_state.schema.json, set ds_t_duration to {{ds_t_duration}}]
Set DashAbility.dashDuration to {{ds_t_duration}} seconds.

[Gameplan: update .gameplan/statemachine/properties/dash_state.schema.json, set ds_t_cooldown to {{ds_t_cooldown}}]
Set DashAbility.dashCooldown to {{ds_t_cooldown}} seconds.
